# ![gtUtils](man/figures/wordmark.svg)

Themes, coloring functions, and utilities that extend
[gt](https://gt.rstudio.com/) for building beautiful tables in R.

## Install

``` r
remotes::install_github("andreweatherman/gtUtils")
```

## What's inside

[Themes](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html#themes) ·
[Color](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html#coloring) ·
[Annotations](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html#annotations) ·
[Layout](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html#layout) ·
[Saving](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html#viewing-saving)

See the [full function reference](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/reference/index.html)
for everything the package offers.

- [Styling Headers, Legends, and Captions](https://gtutils.aweatherman.com/articles/styling.html)
